description: This file defines an abstract controller class named AbstractModuleController within the OrangeHRM system. It includes a property for a HomePageService instance and a method to retrieve or initialize this service, facilitating dependency management for subclasses.

classes.name: AbstractModuleController
classes.description: An abstract class that extends AbstractController, providing a protected property for HomePageService and a getter method to access or instantiate it.

methods.name: getHomePageService
methods.description: Returns the HomePageService instance, creating it if it doesn't already exist.
